title: IOL Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd - 524164 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

summary.headline: IOL Chemicals announced ~INR500 crore across three initiatives, including Ibuprofen capacity up 6,000 MTPA to 18,000 MTPA, commissioning by December 2027.
summary.overview: Management held a business update call on three growth initiatives totalling about INR500 crore: a 6,000 MTPA Ibuprofen expansion (taking capacity to 18,000 MTPA), a 1,500 million tablets per annum CDMO formulation facility with EU GMP certification, and a customer-led specialty chemical facility under a long-term tolling arrangement. Management said about 30% of total funding has already been spent and the rest will come from internal accruals over FY27 and FY28. Management said the three projects together would add 25% to 30% to top line once fully utilised, around FY29. Guidance for FY27 was kept at roughly 15% to 20% growth. Several answers on CDMO economics, margins and timelines were qualitative or deferred.

segments.name: Ibuprofen (API)
segments.commentary: Capacity to rise from 12,000 to 18,000 MTPA via 6,000 MTPA fully backward-integrated expansion, commissioning by December 2027. Management cited existing capacity at 90-95% utilisation and optimal utilisation above 80% in FY28-FY29, with ~25% utilisation in FY28.

segments.name: CDMO formulations
segments.commentary: New 1,500 million tablets per annum facility (or equivalent DCG volume) with EU GMP certification, targeting European anchor customers; commercialisation expected by end of Q3 FY27. Management guided asset turn of 1x to 1.25x at ~90% utilisation, with optimal utilisation in 18 to 24 months.

segments.name: Specialty chemicals
segments.commentary: Dedicated facility under long-term tolling arrangement with a leading global chemical company; customer-funded, providing visibility on long-term manufacturing demand. No financial metrics disclosed; product is new to IOL's portfolio, with development completed.

guidance_outlook: FY27 top-line growth guided at ~15% to 20%, unchanged from the prior call; the new capex is not expected to be material in FY27.

Ibuprofen expansion: commercialisation around Q3 FY28; ~25% utilisation in FY28; optimal utilisation above 80% in FY28-FY29. Asset turn of ~1.75x of investment at peak utilisation, i.e. ~INR600-620 crore peak revenue per management's implied figure, described as tentative.
CDMO: fully operationalised in next financial year (FY28); optimal utilisation in next 18 to 24 months.
Three initiatives expected to add 25% to 30% to top line once fully operational, around FY29.
Management said the capex would not hit EBIT, and that the company expects ~15% ROCE once all projects are implemented.

Pricing: Paracetamol prices have softened from their peak over the past six months; Ibuprofen prices are said to be hovering at roughly the same level, and management indicated possible margin expansion from backward integration.
capex_capacity: Ibuprofen: 6,000 MTPA expansion, taking total capacity to 18,000 MTPA; fully backward integrated; commissioning by December 2027 per management.
CDMO: ~1,500 million tablets per annum (or equivalent DCG volume) at a new facility with EU GMP certification; commercialisation expected by end of Q3 FY27.

Separate greenfield project on a new ~100-acre site, 25-30 km from the existing site, with a ~INR1,200 crore multi-year capex referenced by an analyst; regulatory approvals mostly secured and initial base work started, full work pending approvals. Management said it has not been delayed.
Funding: fully internal accruals; about 30% of total spend already incurred; balance over FY27 and FY28.
demand_pricing: Ibuprofen: management cited high utilisation, growing requirements from established and new customers (domestic and international), and a global Ibuprofen growth rate of 3% to 4% per year. Management did not share the share of incremental capacity backed by specific customers.

Pricing: Paracetamol prices have softened from their peak in the last six months; most APIs have stabilised; Ibuprofen prices have not changed much from current levels, and management said no sharp increase in international Ibuprofen pricing.
Raw material pass-through: contracts include price adjustment clauses that trigger beyond a set band; the Ibuprofen and Paracetamol backward integration controls most raw-material exposure.

CDMO demand: customer-led, with soft commitments from anchor customers in Europe; contract tenure stated as 3 to 5 years, similar to API contracts, but contracts not yet finalised. Management said a regulatory process will delay commercial volumes.
Management said the Middle East conflict impact on feedstock costs has been neutralised.

qa_highlights.question: What revenue and utilisation can the Ibuprofen expansion achieve, and when?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said peak revenue is about 1.75x investment, tentative and dependent on geography, customers and cycles; utilisation about 25% in FY28 and optimal above 80% in FY28-FY29.

qa_highlights.question: What are the CDMO revenue and margin expectations?
qa_highlights.answer: Asset turn of 1x to 1.25x at ~90% utilisation on average; margins are said to be better than API margins, but no number was given. Optimal utilisation in 18 to 24 months.

qa_highlights.question: Where is the Ibuprofen demand coming from, given it is a commodity product?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited current capacity at 90-95% use, customer developments in API and CDMO, and global Ibuprofen growth of 3% to 4%. It denied knowledge of any European plant shutdown.

qa_highlights.question: What is the CDMO customer arrangement, and do the products use IOL's existing APIs?
qa_highlights.answer: European customers asked IOL to supply bulk tablets instead of APIs. Products are existing ones (e.g., Pantoprazole, Clopidogrel, Ibuprofen, Metformin) using captive API, on 3 to 5 year contracts with escalation clauses.

qa_highlights.question: What is the specialty chemical tolling opportunity?
qa_highlights.answer: A product not currently in IOL's portfolio, developed and to be supplied under a mutual agreement with a renowned customer as an addition to the portfolio. No financials disclosed.

qa_highlights.question: Will the capex affect EBIT or cash flow in FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said EBIT will not be hit and the balance capex will be funded from operations. The top-line contribution this year is 'not very material'; the 25% to 30% uplift applies at full utilisation around FY29.

qa_highlights.question: What is the planned capex and ROCE for the three projects?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects about 15% ROCE for the company once all projects are fully implemented. It said the INR495 crore capex is separate from the INR1,200 crore greenfield project at another site.

qa_highlights.question: Will Ibuprofen margins expand?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Ibuprofen prices are roughly flat, and with full backward integration, margin expansion is probable. Pass-through of raw material fluctuation is limited by contract clauses and integration.

financial_highlights.metric: Total proposed investment across three initiatives
Share of total funding already incurred
Expected ROCE for company once all projects fully implemented
Incremental top-line contribution from three initiatives once fully operational

risks_watch: CDMO commercialisation timing: management said commercialisation is expected by end of next quarter and volumes will be delayed by regulatory approval; contracts with anchor customers not yet finalised.

Ibuprofen capacity fill: expansion of 6,000 MTPA (50% increase) with ~25% utilisation in FY28 and optimal above 80% in FY28-FY29; the share of incremental volume backed by named customers was not disclosed.

Ibuprofen pricing and margin: management said prices are flat and expected margin expansion from backward integration, but the company is adding capacity while some competitors are reportedly exiting, so price direction is a key watch item.
Greenfield ~INR1,200 crore project at a separate ~100-acre site: regulatory approvals mostly secured but full work pending approvals; no timeline or capex confirmation given on the call.

Revenue and margin figures are unquantified: CDMO margins were not given, peak revenue of 1.75x is tentative, and FY27 growth guidance of 15% to 20% was held without FY28 numbers. Track next quarter for CDMO revenue and any margin disclosure.
key_quotes: Around 30% of overall funding requirements has already been incurred.
This is customer -led investment, providing visibility of long-term manufacturing demand.
I think this will be very early to discuss on the exact margin numbers.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident on the strategic rationale and the internal funding, but cautious and often evasive on numbers. It gave 1.75x asset-turn and 1x to 1.25x CDMO guidance only with heavy disclaimers, declined to quantify CDMO margins or customer share of the new Ibuprofen capacity, and deferred the 3 to 5 year CDMO outlook.
